content.text: I hope all is well with you and Anne. —Anthony

Thanks Anthony, Anne has out-patient surgery tomorrow morning at Vanderbilt. Her white counts were normal this winter so she was able to begin the reconstruction process and this is the final step. I will stay and get everything stabilized at home, then head back to Detroit late Monday night. Thank you again for the well wishes.  We need a rally!
My thoughts are with her! I will be watching from the couch this weekend, too. Weather in Minny looks terrible. Talk soon.
